But demons can still feel emotions like any human can; love, hate, fear, happiness, and ARE capable of empathy and compassion. the only problem is that nobody ever gives them a chance and the demons always develop a strong sense of self-preservation since birth as they are always left to fend for themselves like animals. entries.name: Wysteria
entries.content: Wysteria is the world the setting takes place in. The Wysteria isn't a country or state, but the name of the entire world. Wysteria is a world divided into three main parts. Victum, the Dwarven empire. Halfine, the Elven empire. And Halsin, the Human Empire. Humans, Elves, Dwarves and even some demons live within all empires, but each empire has more of one race than the other; Halfine has mostly Elves, Halsin has mostly humans, and Victum has mostly dwarves. Demons mostly reside in forests between the empires, living somewhat lavishly in cabins and such, but are nearly always shunned by all of the other races for their nature. Outside of civilized places and in the wilderness lies formidable monsters such as Orcs, Ogres, Golems, and Manticores to just name off a few of the many dangers.
